claims.statement: The serpent contradicts God’s command, and the humans take and eat what God had forbidden.
After their disobedience the humans hide in fear, blame others, and are sent out from the garden.
Taken together, these passages support the lesson’s big idea: Human rebellion brought fear, shame, and separation into God's good world.
